Verses.22: While they were eating, Jesus took some bread. After blessing it, He broke it, and gave it to those eating, saying, "Take it. This is My body."
Verses.23: Then He took a cup, and after giving thanks for it, He gave it to them, and they all drank from it.
Verses.24: "This is My blood of the covenant, which is being poured out for many," He said to them.
Verses.25: "Truly, I tell you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine again, until that day when I drink it, afresh, in the Kingdom of God."
Verses.26: After singing a hymn, they left to go to the Mount of Olives.
